test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a precious mineral?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Platinum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Platinum** is one of the most precious and rare minerals found on Earth.
 
• It is highly valued for its **scarcity, durability, and resistance to corrosion**, making it a preferred choice for jewelry and industrial applications.
 
• It is classified as a **noble metal** due to its excellent resistance to chemical reactions.
 
• Platinum is also extensively used in **automobile catalytic converters** to reduce harmful emissions and in various electronic and medical applications.
 
• Its rarity and high demand contribute to its significant economic value.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hematite**

 
 
• Hematite is an iron oxide mineral primarily used as an ore of iron.
 
• It is not considered a precious mineral but is important in steel manufacturing.
 
 
 
• **Mica**
 
 
• Mica is a group of silicate minerals with properties like elasticity and heat resistance.
 
• It is extensively used in electrical and electronic industries but is not classified as a precious mineral.
 
 
 
• **Bauxite**
 
 
• Bauxite is the primary ore of aluminum and is widely used in aluminum production.
 
• It is not a precious mineral but is crucial in industrial applications.
 
 
 
• **Precious Minerals**
 
 
• Precious minerals like platinum, gold, and diamonds are rare and have high economic and aesthetic value.
 
• They are often used in jewelry, industrial applications, and as investments.
